Program Description

Nurses serve as advocates for patients, families and communities. The Nursing Program is committed to preparing graduates with a collaborative, innovative and experiential focus in the practice of nursing, while serving society as healthcare leaders. Learn from experts, Findlay's faculty are experts within their nursing specialties. Students will gain experience in Findlay's nursing care skills lab, simulation and throughout clinical practice. Findlay's nursing program emphasizes on:

  • Critical thinking
  • Professional leadership
  • Emerging trends in healthcare
  • Health and human functioning
  • Professional ethics, diversity and healthcare management

Graduates are eligible to take the licensure exam to become a Registered Nurse.
6hjx:
Program Description

In an increasingly data-driven world, businesses are leveraging information to gain a key, competitive advantage. Corporate investment and jobs in business analytics are expected to grow as businesses need to make sense of the data they are collecting. Business analytics refers to the knowledge, skills, and competencies required for the methodical exploration and investigation of business data. This includes using predictive and prescriptive statistical tools to support decision-making and to gain insight of business performance. There is a growing need in the market for well-rounded graduates who are able to transform data into meaningful information that can be used for strategic decision-making.

The Business Analytics Emphasis provides students with the skills to collect, analyze, understand, and interpret data. It exposes students to a variety of information systems and data through a series of business analytics courses. Students will also be provided with hands-on experience of statistical tools used in the business environment using data provided by industry partners. Findlay's curriculum is designed to support a seamless transition from student to business professional.

Find careers in: market research analyst, data architect, financial analyst, business analyst, quantitative analyst, and operations research analyst.

Program Description

Join the corporate world with a business emphasis. An emphasis in business prepares students for careers in the corporate or small business environment. Graduates will be able to design new systems to meet the needs of the client and integrate new computer technologies as appropriate, to increase the power of existing computer systems. This is vital to the success of any organization. To complete a Computer Science degree with a Business Emphasis students must complete seven business emphasis courses in addition to the computer science core courses.

Some Business Emphasis course options are: Fundamentals of Accounting Information, Principles of Management, Applied Operations Research, Internet Programming Unix, Internet Programming Windows, and more.
6hk9:
Program Description

At University of Findlay, an emphasis in computer systems prepares students for careers as network administrators or software engineers. Graduates will be able to provide expertise in the design, monitoring, and maintenance of organizational networks. To complete a Computer Science degree with a Computer Systems Emphasis students must complete six computer systems emphasis courses in addition to the computer science core courses.

Some courses in the Computer Systems Emphasis are: Information Security Fundamentals, Computer Systems Administration, Secure E-commerce, Computer and Network Forensics, Internet Programming Windows, and more.
6hm2:
Program Description

University of Findlay's program provides students with the medical knowledge, technical skills, and experience in a variety of didactic and clinical settings necessary for them to become ethical, competent, and compassionate health care providers as part of a health care team.​​ The mission of the Physician Assistant program at The University of Findlay is to provide students with the medical knowledge, technical skills, and experience in a variety of didactic and clinical settings necessary for them to become ethical, competent, and compassionate health care providers as part of the health care team. This mission complements the University of Findlay's mission which is to equip students for meaningful lives and productive careers.

Physician assistant graduates are expected to be able to function as health professionals who when licensed can practice medicine with physician supervision to respond to the needs of their patients in ways that will improve their quality of life. Students will train full-time in a variety of clinical settings. A clinical experience in their area of interest is also required. Students will learn hands-on with experienced faculty in state-of-the-art facilities right on campus.

100% of Findlay's graduates from 2010 to present passed the Physician Assistant National Certifying Exam (PANCE), with 99% of those graduates passing on the first attempt.​

Students will gain enhanced IT knowledge through University of Findlay's Master of Science in Applied Security and Analytics Program. Findlay's advanced courses in leadership, big data analytics and cybersecurity will expand students' business skills in strategic planning, finance, security and project management.

Courses designed to teach students:

  • Project Management
  • Management of Information Technology
  • Applied Security Principles
  • Statistical Methods for Business Analytics
  • Secure Coding
  • Advanced Software Engineering
  • Data Mining for Decision Making

6hm0:
Program Description

Informatics is the science of processing data for storage and retrieval. Every day​ we benefit from the outcomes of informatics. Health informatics uses the same principle of processing data, but for the purpose of improving healthcare outcomes. The data collected at doctors' offices, clinics, and pharmacies plays a critical role in healthcare reform. If students want to be part of the driving force that decreases costs and improves outcomes in the healthcare industry, pursuing a career in the field of health informatics could be right for them.
6hlx:
Program Description

The global economy is dependent on strong business leaders who are equipped to make big decisions and even bigger moves for long-term success. Professionals who can navigate complex business issues, analyze and implement effective business strategies and policies as well as consistently motivate team members are best suited for top leadership roles in today's growing and demanding global business environment.

The Master of Business Administration (MBA) at University of Findlay prepares tomorrow’s business leaders through a comprehensive curriculum focused on personal and professional development. Students gain a global perspective for smart business leadership in today’s increasingly diverse marketplace. Students will also grow their leadership skills to positively impact their life as well as the lives of whom they manage.

​Students can customize their MBA by picking a concentration that fits their interests and career goals.

MBA core courses teach how business and management work and how they relate to the external environment. MBA students are introduced to the functional activities of organizations, learn managerial skills and the use of analytical tools for decision making. In the MBA program, they will be able to apply the skills learned throughout coursework into their current job right away. To best fit students' interests and career goals, the MBA program offers concentrations in a variety of areas:

Specialized Concentrations

Business Administration (Standard MBA)​

Certified Management Accountant (CMA)​

Certified Public Accountant (CPA)​

Healthcare Management​

Optional Second Concentrations

Students seeking additional expertise in a specific area can earn a second concentration by adding just a couple more courses. The MBA program offers the following second concentrations:

Finance

Human resource management

International business

Marketing

Operations management
